turns.text: Speaking of work, how do you feel about the job itself?
turns.zh: 说到工作，你觉得这份工作本身怎么样？

turns.text: Are you learning anything useful there?
turns.zh: 你在那儿有学到什么有用的东西吗？

turns.text: I've gotten really good at customer service and I've learned about inventory management and ordering systems.
turns.zh: 我客服这块真的练得很熟了，还学了库存管理和订货系统。

turns.text: Being around books all day has gotten me interested in literature again, too.
turns.zh: 整天跟书待在一起，也让我重新对文学感兴趣了。

turns.text: You know, you were always such a good reader when you were younger.
turns.zh: 你知道吧，你年轻的时候一直特别爱读书。

turns.text: Maybe that's something worth exploring academically.
turns.zh: 也许这值得在学业上好好探索一下。
